review_scope: Independent read-only scientific/design inspection. Actual encoded visuals and clock remain pending; no renderer edits or author-test substitution.

time_axis.interpretation: Each ordinary frame samples its displayed model time; the final chronological frame precedes the calendar boundary by one video-frame interval. The closing sample supports interpolation through that last hour.

trails.interpretation: Seed residence age is distinct from bright trail memory. The chosen retention has a roughly 2.8-hour model-time e-folding, suitable for showing changing hourly fields without keeping the former mean-film long bright history. Trails still show recent history, not an instantaneous arrow field or measured water paths.

advection.scope: Model-based projected flow visualization, not observed parcel trajectories or transport-conservative reconstruction.

initialization.interpretation: Visual seeding/ink initialization, separately recorded by renderer; no extra source hours are invented.

river.risk: Time-evolving NOAA lake and constant independent river field are not a physically matched transient coupled model. Inspect the upstream handoff and Carleton at several chronological phases for visual starvation.

restart.interpretation: Explicit editorial replay transition rather than an inferred weather evolution from last to first. The middle of the dissolve superimposes two endpoint images and must not be interpreted as a model state.

final_encoded_review_required: Actual UTC clock progression and replay badge legibility
Changing currents and temperature over the week
Capped temperature legend and fixed river-period footer
Carleton and the upstream lake-river handoff at several times
